title: Qt: Extend welcome page accessibility information
description:
Building on the great accessibility groundwork laid in !23543, this adds
further accessible names and descriptions to welcome page widgets that
were not yet covered.

Consolidates the accessible name and description for the welcome page
itself into the WelcomePage base class constructor, using the application
name dynamically so that both Wireshark and Stratoshark are handled by a
single generic string without app-specific branching. Removes the now-
redundant override from StratosharkWelcomePage.

Adds accessible name and description to the capture source type filter
button, the capture sources frame, and the capture filter combo box, again
using neutral terminology so the strings apply equally to both applications.

Adds Qt::AccessibleTextRole to the recent capture files model so that
screen readers announce the full item text including file size or, for
files that can no longer be found at their path, an explicit "file no
longer found at path" suffix rather than just the bare filename.

AI-Assisted: yes [claude-sonnet-4-6]
